title: 消费新观念
text: 在超市里，人们面对琳琅满目的商品。现代生活让购物变得极其方便。许多人习惯购买不需要的东西。这种行为导致资源浪费严重。过度消费给环境带来巨大压力。我们应当思考可持续发展的意义。绿色消费不仅是趋势，更是责任。选择耐用的产品能减少垃圾产生。高质量物品既实用又环保。减少塑料袋使用是简单起步。尽量购买当地生产的食材。这样可以降低运输过程中的碳排放。企业也需要改变生产模式。他们应采用可回收材料。循环经济能有效缓解资源短缺。消费者应当抵制盲目跟风。理性选择既省钱又高效。我们需要建立简约的生活方式。减少不必要的支出能提升幸福感。保护自然资源关乎后代利益。每个人微小的改变都会产生影响。社会应当推广环保理念。通过教育提高公民意识。让低碳生活成为一种习惯。共同构建和谐的生态系统。这是时代赋予我们的任务。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is a simple first step toward sustainable consumption?
Why does the text recommend buying locally produced food?
options: To reduce carbon emissions from transportation

questions.prompt: What does the text say about choosing durable, high-quality products?
options: They are both practical and environmentally friendly, reducing waste
They are always more expensive with no benefit
They contribute just as much waste as cheap products
They are only relevant for luxury goods

questions.prompt: What should enterprises do, according to the text, to support sustainable consumption?
options: Lower product quality to reduce costs

questions.prompt: According to the text, what benefit does reducing unnecessary spending bring?
options: It has no effect on wellbeing
It always leads to social isolation

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
